title: GoOrganicAfrica 44-country calculator readiness — DRC follow-up: first-level geography

administrative_geography.special_status: Kinshasa is a city-province and is included in the 26 provincial-level entities.
caveats: The Ministry says its map geometry is indicative and legal texts/official maps prevail.
Province selector presence is not province-level crop-data coverage.
Lower-level territory/sector records were not added.

new_findings: The DRC Ministry of Interior page confirms 26 provincial-level entities and lists all 26 names, including Kinshasa city-province.
The Ministry warns that its displayed map boundaries are indicative open data; legal instruments and official maps prevail.
An open CC-BY-4.0 dataset advertises 164 territories and 519 sectors, but this lower-level compilation is a lead only and was not integrated.
safeguards: No existing active country profile or calculator formula was changed.
No national aggregate or modelled forecast was converted to a province-level observation.
No World Bank market estimate was relabelled as a farmgate price.
Lower-level divisions were not integrated without legal and spatial crosswalk validation.
No merge, pull request or production deployment was performed.
next_step: Extract and reconcile official crop-specific province/season observations, inspect market data price-type/confidence flags, and obtain dated farmgate prices and farmer-paid input costs before enterprise budgets or calculator tests.
